settings.automaticUpdates: Keep the app up to date
settings.automaticUpdates_desc: WeBeep Sync will periodically check for new updates, and will install them automatically
settings.keepOpenInBackground_desc: Keep the app running in background while all windows are closed. If autosync is enabled, they will happen in background too
settings.trayWarning: With the tray disabled, you wont be able to tell if the app is running. Once you close the window, you'll need to relaunch the app to open it again. If you have autosyncs enabled, those will keep going in the background.
settings.notifications: Send a notification when new files are downloaded in background
settings.msgNotifications: Send a notification when I recieve a new message in WeBeep
settings.newCourses_desc: When new courses are found, automatically add them to the courses that will be synced
settings.concurrentDownloads_desc: A higher number of concurrent downloads can increase download speeds, but could put more load on your network. A lower number is preferable for slower connections.
settings.recordingsStartCollapsed_desc: Keep the recordings list compact when the app opens.
settings.recordingsEnabled_desc: Periodically discover WebEx recordings in selected courses
settings.recordingsSyncInterval_desc: How often to check for new recordings
settings.recordingsDownloadPath_desc: Where to save downloaded video files
settings.recordingsMaxConcurrent_desc: Maximum number of recordings to download simultaneously
settings.transcriberWhisperModel_desc: Larger models are more accurate but require more time and memory.
settings.transcriberWhisperNumCores_desc: Number of CPU cores used by each transcription. The default is 2.
settings.credentialsNote: Credentials are used to access WebEx and download recordings. They are stored encrypted on your computer.
settings.discoveryHelp: Check now scans selected courses. Full rescan retries every link; regular checks reuse successful results and retry failures.
settings.recordingsAutoDownload_desc: Download newly discovered lectures during scheduled checks.
settings.recordingsAutoTranscribe_desc: Queue each new download for transcription. Only one lecture is transcribed at a time.
settings.notesModeHelp: Generated notes use your selected provider’s local CLI sign-in. Transcript and prompt-pack modes do not require it.
settings.advancedHelp: The included worker and downloader are detected automatically. Override these paths only for a custom installation.
settings.aboutDescription: WeBeep course files, recording downloads and lecture transcription in one app. Based on the original WeBeep Sync.
settings.loadFailed: Settings could not be loaded. Close this dialog and try again.
settings.invalidNumber: Enter a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.
settings.transcriberNotesProvider_desc: Use the locally signed-in Codex or Claude CLI to generate notes.
settings.transcriberNotesModel_desc: Leave blank to use the selected provider’s default model.

courseList.courses_desc: Select which courses you want to keep synced and rename the folders
